title: The Manufactured Hero
logline: An actor hired to play a war hero for propaganda decides to expose the fake war, and asks a pilot to destroy the director's yacht.

roles.description: Handsome, deeply depressed, wearing a fake military uniform.
Loud, artistic, cares only about the lighting and the budget.
A massive soundstage orbiting a dying star, made to look like a battlefield.
An opulent, unarmed cruiser filled with editing equipment.
The government body funding the fake war.

public_situation: The sector is captivated by the heroic exploits of a brave fighter pilot holding the line at the edge of space.
private_truth: There is no war. The "hero" is an actor, and the footage is being filmed on a massive set to justify massive military budgets.

beats.public_change: The director demands more realistic explosions for the finale.

missions.reason: The director hires the pilot to deliver ferrite to build a massive, rigged prop supercarrier for the finale.
missions.private_fact: The actor is staring out the window, quietly weeping.

beats.public_change: The actor refuses to read their lines, demanding the truth be told.

missions.reason: The actor begs the pilot to meet a disillusioned prop master and collect the real master script proving the entire war is a fabrication.
missions.private_fact: The pilot has to dodge automated pyrotechnics to reach the script.

beats.public_change: The director prepares to broadcast the grand finale.

missions.reason: The actor pays the pilot to destroy the director's yacht and recover the master tapes before they can be broadcast.
missions.private_fact: The director hails the pilot, offering to make them a star in the next season if they back down.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot has the master tapes. The director is offering fame and fortune to hand them over.

options.label: Help the actor expose the fake war
Sell out and give the tapes to the director

resolutions.summary: The tapes are destroyed. The actor leaks the script, exposing the fake war. The military budget is slashed, and the director is ruined.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped a guilt-ridden actor expose a massive fake war propaganda campaign.

resolutions.summary: The finale broadcasts. The sector weeps for the "hero," who is quietly murdered by the director to prevent future leaks. The pilot becomes rich.
The director broadcasts the finale without interference. The actor is permanently silenced, and the fake war continues to draw billions in funding.

loose_threads.detail: The fake war was funded by a massive colonial expansion corporation that needed an excuse to build supercarriers.
The actor reveals they were originally a prisoner of war, forced into the role to save their family.

radio_hooks: Season finale of the frontier war to broadcast tonight.

voice_direction.guilt_ridden_actor: Deep, incredibly sad, speaks with theatrical enunciation.
voice_direction.cynical_director: Loud, abrasive, constantly yelling at unseen crew.
